mainTopic: End of פרק קדשי קדשים and the opening משנה of the next פרק: when a bird sin offering (חטאת העוף) carries מעילה, when it can become disqualified, and when its meat carries the penalties of פיגול, נותר and טמא.
overview: The amud opens with the last line of the previous discussion: even רבי עקיבא agrees that sprinkling the blood does not make the meat permitted for eating. Then the Hadran closes the chapter קדשי קדשים. A new chapter begins with a משנה about the bird sin offering (חטאת העוף), laid out in three stages. From the moment it is consecrated, מעילה applies. Once its neck is pinched (מליקה), it can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight. Once its blood is sprinkled, eating it can bring liability for פיגול, נותר and טמא, but מעילה no longer applies. The גמרא then notices that the משנה says a טבול יום only disqualifies the bird and does not make it טמא. It asks whose view this is and answers that it is the רבנן. It begins quoting a ברייתא with the opposing view of אבא שאול, which continues on the next amud.

steps.title: רבי עקיבא agrees: sprinkling does not permit the meat for eating
steps.stepSummary: The previous discussion ends with a limit on רבי עקיבא's view: the sprinkling of the blood does not make the meat permitted for eating.
steps.simpleTranslation: But as for eating, that is where [the sprinkling] does not make it acceptable.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the closing line of the previous discussion. It says that even רבי עקיבא agrees that sprinkling the blood does not make the meat permitted to eat.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The earlier discussion was about meat that left its proper area before the blood was sprinkled. רבי עקיבא holds that the sprinkling still has some effect on such meat. This line limits that: the sprinkling does not make the meat permitted for eating.

keyTerms.meaning: Eating. Here it means making the sacrificial meat permitted to eat.
Makes acceptable. It brings about the sacrifice's proper effect.
Sprinkling of the blood. This is the unstated subject the line is talking about.

phrases.notes: This picks up from the earlier discussion: sprinkling helps in one way, but not for eating.

phrases.english: that is where it does not make it acceptable.
phrases.notes: The 'it' is the sprinkling of the blood.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes the discussion from the previous daf about רבי עקיבא's view.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: Even according to רבי עקיבא, sprinkling the blood does not permit meat that left its proper area to be eaten.

steps.title: Hadran: closing the chapter קדשי קדשים
steps.stepSummary: The formula marking the end of the chapter קדשי קדשים.
steps.simpleTranslation: We will return to you, קדשי קדשים.
steps.whatsHappening: This line closes the chapter. It is not part of the argument; it just marks that the chapter is finished.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The Hadran is a traditional farewell to a chapter that has been completed, expressing the hope to come back and learn it again. Nothing new is ruled here.

keyTerms.meaning: We will return to you. This is the formula said when finishing a chapter.
Offerings of the highest holiness. This is also the name of the chapter just finished.

phrases.english: We will return to you, Kodshei Kodashim

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the chapter after its final discussion.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The chapter קדשי קדשים is complete.

steps.title: Bird sin offering: מעילה from consecration, disqualification from pinching
steps.stepSummary: The new chapter's משנה rules that מעילה applies to a חטאת העוף from the moment it is consecrated. Once it is pinched, it can become disqualified through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight.
steps.simpleTranslation: A bird sin offering: one is liable for מעילה with it from when it was consecrated. Once it was pinched, it became able to be disqualified by a טבול יום, by a מחוסר כפורים, and by being left overnight.
steps.whatsHappening: A new chapter opens with a משנה about the bird sin offering. It lists the first two stages in the bird's life and what law starts at each stage.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Just being consecrated is enough for מעילה: using the bird for personal benefit is misuse of holy property. Disqualification only becomes possible after מליקה, the pinching of the neck that slaughters it. From then on, contact with a טבול יום or a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight, can make it פסול.

keyTerms.meaning: A bird sin offering.
Misuse of holy property for personal benefit.
Pinching the back of a bird's neck with the כהן's fingernail. This is how bird offerings are slaughtered.
A person who immersed today and must wait until nightfall to become fully pure.
A person who still has to bring an atonement offering to finish becoming pure, such as a זב or a מצורע.
Being left overnight, which disqualifies sacrifices.

steps.confusionAlert: Don't mix up the two lists. מעילה starts as soon as the bird is consecrated. The ability to become פסול starts only later, at מליקה.

phrases.english: A bird sin offering: one is liable for misuse with it from when it was consecrated,
once it was pinched, it became able to be disqualified
by one who immersed that day and by one lacking atonement
phrases.notes: Being touched by these people is what can make the bird פסול.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts the new chapter after the Hadran.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מעילה applies to a חטאת העוף from consecration. After מליקה, it can become פסול through a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight.

steps.title: After the blood is sprinkled: פיגול, נותר and טמא apply, but no מעילה
steps.stepSummary: Once the bird's blood has been sprinkled, eating it can make one liable for פיגול, נותר and טמא, but מעילה no longer applies.
steps.simpleTranslation: Once its blood was sprinkled, one is liable for it because of פיגול, נותר and טמא, and there is no מעילה with it.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה finishes with the last stage: after the blood is sprinkled. It says which prohibitions now start and which one ends.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Sprinkling the blood is the step that permits the meat to the כהנים. So now the eating prohibitions of פיגול, נותר and טמא apply to it. For the same reason, מעילה ends: the meat is now meant to be eaten by the כהנים rather than being reserved only for ה׳.

keyTerms.meaning: Sprinkling the blood. For a bird sin offering, the blood is sprinkled on the מזבח.
A sacrifice ruined by an improper intention to eat it after its permitted time. Eating it carries כרת.
Sacrificial meat left past its time limit.
Here, eating sacrificial meat while ritually impure.
Spiritual cutting-off, the penalty for these violations.

steps.whatToRemember: The three stages are: consecration means מעילה; pinching means it can become פסול; sprinkling means פיגול, נותר and טמא apply, and מעילה ends.
steps.whyThisMatters: This shows a pattern found throughout מעילה: once the meat becomes permitted to the כהנים, misuse of holy property no longer applies.

phrases.english: Once its blood was sprinkled, one is liable for it
because of piggul, notar, and impurity,
phrases.notes: The liability is for eating the meat, and the penalty is כרת.

phrases.english: and there is no misuse with it.

steps.triggerLanguage: הוּזָּה דָּמָהּ חַיָּיבִין עָלָיו מִשּׁוּם פִּיגּוּל
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the משנה's stages with the last one, the sprinkling of the blood.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: After the blood is sprinkled, one is liable for פיגול, נותר and טמא, but מעילה no longer applies.

steps.title: Reading the משנה closely: disqualified, but not made impure
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא notes that the משנה says a טבול יום only makes the bird פסול. He does not make it טמא.
steps.simpleTranslation: The גמרא: The משנה teaches that once the bird is pinched, it can be disqualified by a טבול יום, a מחוסר כפורים, or being left overnight. Disqualified, yes. Made impure, no.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא opens its discussion by drawing a careful inference from the exact wording of the משנה. This sets up the next question: whose opinion is this?
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה used the word לִיפָּסֵל, which means 'to become disqualified.' It did not say the טבול יום makes the bird טמא. From that word choice the גמרא learns that a טבול יום only ruins the bird for eating. He does not give it a level of טומאה that could spread to other things.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion of the משנה begins here
To become disqualified (פסול), unfit to be eaten or offered
To make it טמא (ritually impure)

steps.confusionAlert: פסול and טמא are not the same thing. Something פסול just can't be used. Something טמא has real impurity that can pass on to other things.

phrases.english: It teaches: it became fit to be disqualified
by one who immersed that day, by one lacking atonement, and by being left overnight.
but to be made impure – no.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Begins the גמרא on the משנה quoted in step 3 by drawing an inference from its wording.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to the משנה, a טבול יום only makes the pinched bird פסול. He does not make it טמא.

steps.title: Whose opinion does the משנה follow?
steps.stepSummary: Based on that inference, the גמרא asks who the author of the משנה is.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks which תנא holds that a טבול יום only disqualifies and does not make things טמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Not every תנא agrees about the power of a טבול יום. So the inference from step 5 is not obvious to everyone. The גמרא wants to identify whose view it matches.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Whose is our משנה?' A standard question asking which תנא the משנה follows

phrases.english: Our mishna – whose view is it?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Follows directly from the inference in step 5.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which תנא holds that a טבול יום disqualifies but does not make things טמא.

steps.title: It follows the רבנן, against אבא שאול
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that the משנה follows the רבנן. It begins quoting a ברייתא where אבא שאול holds differently.
steps.simpleTranslation: It is the view of the רבנן, as a ברייתא teaches: אבא שאול says: a טבול יום...
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא identifies the author as the רבנן. It starts bringing a ברייתא to show there is a disagreement on this point.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The ברייתא will show that אבא שאול gives a טבול יום a stronger effect on קדשים. That is why the משנה, which only says 'disqualify,' must follow the רבנן who argue with him. The quote is cut off here and continues next.

keyTerms.meaning: The Sages, the majority view that argues with an individual תנא
'It is the רבנן.' A phrase naming who the author of a source is

phrases.english: It is the view of the Rabbis,
as it is taught in a baraita:
Abba Shaul says: one who immersed that day

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question of step 6 and begins citing support.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The משנה follows the רבנן, who argue with אבא שאול about the power of a טבול יום.
steps.raayaSupportSource: A ברייתא quoting אבא שאול, continued in the next section.
